summary: Flat residential kerb, cars park here, but homes 13-15 m away all round.

drivers.seclusion: Houses about 14-15 m behind the kerb, with homes across the road; no bush or park buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street; cars park along the kerb so room to stop.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street; no camping convention.

flags: Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, unnamed waterway 118 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the north side near the start.

best_section.where: Dobell Street south kerb along the bend, mid-stretch
